lines: From the memory that was embraced, a red droplet spilled out
It’s not something to show to others
The unspoken words became another part of me
Something is shouting from inside my body
Ah, I wanted it, I was angry about it
No, I’ll hide everything, I’m sorry
Because being sad alone is enough
Because I don’t want to become any uglier
Unfound by anyone inside me
You cried until you turned this color, how beautiful
From the heart that failed to hand over, a blue droplet spilled out
It’s not something to throw at others
I swallow it completely, sinking to the bottom of a distant sea
I’ll wait, unchanged, to become a jewel or something
I decorate truth with lies, comforting myself with a make‑believe life
I heal my own tragedy with someone else’s tragedy
Staying exactly as the moment I drowned in longing
I can’t breathe, I simply love
Because being sad alone is enough
Because I don’t want to become any uglier
Unfound by anyone inside me
You cried until you turned this color, how beautiful
I’m sorry
Hey, how beautiful
